page_title: Clayface Wins Big: Your Zodiac Box Office Report
date_caption: Created October 26, 2026 for the 44th week of 2026.

news.title: You Can See Everything Box Office Huge Second Weekend, Clayface Leads - Variety

weekly_forecast: This week, prepare for the cinematic universe to expand right into your living room! With 'You Can See Everything' still raking in the cash, expect your deepest, darkest secrets to become prime-time viewing. Clayface, our reigning box office champion, will likely demand a spin-off series, forcing all major streaming platforms into a bidding war. Remember, the only thing more transparent than a blockbuster hit is your Aunt Carol's Facebook feed this week.
